project.title: Zad - Fintech Social Media Growth
project.description:
Zad is a fintech app built to help people in Kuwait and the GCC invest in the stock market with more confidence.

Context:
When Astroshot started working with Zad in 2023, the brand needed more than content posting. It needed a social media system that could explain financial products clearly, build trust in a regulated category, and keep the app visible through consistent monthly communication.

Challenge:
The challenge was to make stock market investing feel understandable without making the brand look casual or generic. Fintech content has to be clear, credible, and fast enough for social media, especially when the audience includes new investors across the GCC.

Execution:
Astroshot managed Zad's full social media presence on a monthly basis, supported by a dedicated team covering account management, content creation, design, editing, animation, and videography.

The work covered static content, educational formats, motion graphics, campaign videos, rebranding support, and a TV commercial. This gave Zad one connected brand presence across daily social media, product communication, and higher-profile campaign moments.

Astroshot also helped launch key services for Zad, including Robo Zad, shaping the communication around new features so they could be introduced clearly to the market.

Ongoing Retainer:
The account continued as an ongoing monthly retainer, with Astroshot handling the rhythm of planning, production, publishing support, and visual development for a fintech app operating in Kuwait and the GCC investment space.

Result:
As of the provided August 2026 Instagram profile screenshot, Zad's public Instagram presence shows 48.5K followers.

Ongoing fintech social media management. Rebranding. Motion graphics. TV commercial production. A dedicated Astroshot team behind one GCC investment app.
